title: shorea guiso
intro: Shorea guiso, commonly known as Guis or Kusia, is a tree species native to the Philippines. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Shorea guiso include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
